spans.s: वैध, i. e. विधि + अ, adj. According to rule, ritual.

वैधर्म्य, i. e. वि-धर्म + य, n.
 1. Irreligion, impropriety.
 2. Difference of duty.
 3. Difference, Bhāṣāp. 28; Kusumāñj. 3, 9.
वैधव, i. e. विधु + अ, patronym., m. The son of the moon, i. e. Budha, Vikr. d. 159.
वैधवेय, i. e. विधवा + एय, m. The son of a widow, Śāk. 23, 14 (but read वैधेय).
वैधव्य, i. e. विधवा + य, n. Widowhood, Böhtl. Ind.
वैधात्र, i. e. विधातृ + अ. [] patronym., m. Sanatkumāra, the son of Brahman.
वैधेय (perhaps धेय [vb. धा], compounded with वि and aff. अ), adj. Foolish, a fool,
